SamenvattingStep into the fast-paced world of logistics as a Warehouse Employee at DHL in Eindhoven. This is your opportunity to start or grow your career in a leading logistics company. Join us in Eindhoven and make a difference every day. Good work!Over de functieAs a Warehouse Employee at DHL in Eindhoven, you play a crucial role in the daily logistics operation. You’ll work in a modern warehouse environment where teamwork and accuracy are important. Some packages are lightweight and easy to move, while others require more effort, so being physically fit is essential. 
Your daily tasks include:
Loading and unloading deliveries and sorting parcels by destination
Handling parcels of various sizes and weights, including heavier packages
Using handheld scanners to track and record parcel information
Working as part of a team to ensure all parcels are processed on time

Your working hours are between 20 and 25 per week during the night shift. Shifts start between 02:00 and 03:00 and finish around 08:00, depending on the workload.
Over het bedrijfAt this logistics company, you’ll be joining the DHL Ecom team in Eindhoven. DHL is a global leader in logistics and parcel delivery, known for reliability and innovation. The warehouse is located in a convenient part of Eindhoven, close to main transport routes. You’ll work with a diverse, energetic group that values teamwork and mutual respect. The environment is friendly and supportive, with a clear focus on getting the job done together. Everyone is committed to keeping the operation running smoothly, and teamwork is at the heart of daily life here.

• Good physical condition and ability to lift heavy parcels
• Basic English or Dutch speaking skills
• Punctuality
• Flexible and reliable approach to work

As a logistics employee in the Eemshaven, you’ll ensure that everything runs smoothly in the data centre. You’ll be working in a modern data centre for a major American client.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for a range of tasks: you’ll be loading and unloading heavy goods, which can sometimes be quite a challenge. But don’t worry, you’ll be working alongside great colleagues who’ll lend a hand when needed. You will also check materials and move them to the correct location, where your eye for detail will come in handy. Furthermore, you will be responsible for assembling and partially installing various racks within the data centre and assisting with other logistics processes. Together with the team, you will ensure that everything runs smoothly in the data centre. 

You will work in two shifts, and working days are mainly Monday to Friday, but you may also be asked to help out at weekends to support your colleagues.This is a long-term role (expected to last at least one year) and there is also the possibility of being taken on by the client on a permanent contract.

Are you looking for a long-term role with opportunities for progression? Apply now!

You’re someone who likes to get stuck in and enjoys a hands-on job. You enjoy working in a warehouse and making sure everything runs smoothly.

What you bring to the role:

- You’re fit and strong enough to lift and move heavy items. This ensures everything ends up in the right place.
- You have a proficient level of Dutch and/or English. This is important for working well with your colleagues and following the rules and regulations.
- You have a driving licence and your own transport.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).
- You are willing to obtain your VCA certificate.

Start working at a leading bicycle manufacturing company in Lelystad next week! Here you can put your technical skills to use with guaranteed full-time hours. You will earn €2,867.52 gross per month, with allowances up to 50%. There are plenty of opportunities for growth. Performing well opens up the possibility of a longer-term placement and a permanent contract. Apply immediately as an assembly employee!

What we offer
- Gross monthly salary of €2,867.52
- Travel allowance up to 40 km
- A nice team with enthusiastic colleagues
- Free hot meal, fresh fruit, coffee, and tea
- Chance of a permanent contract
- A job with career opportunities

Who you are
As a assembly employee, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- Available from Monday to Friday (Saturday is optional)
- Available full-time from 7:00 to 16:00
- Able to speak English to work effectively in an international environment
- Possess technical knowledge and the ability to handle tools
- Live in the Lelystad area or have your own reliable transportation

What will you do
Upon arrival in the morning, you will discuss the day with your colleagues over a cup of coffee in the canteen. When it is time to start, you will head to your department where the team leader will brief you on the daily targets. You and your team will then work together to assemble bicycle parts. Each warehouse worker has a dedicated station and specific tasks on the production line—such as installing electric motors or attaching brake cables. Because operations move at a fast pace, precision and efficiency are key to keeping the line running smoothly. Together, you ensure that top-quality bicycles are successfully delivered to customers.

Where will you work
You will join a world-leading brand of high-quality bicycles and cycling equipment within a fun and enthusiastic team. The company is committed to helping everyone reach their full potential, offering numerous career advancement paths such as an operator or trou

Are you looking for a stable full-time position with fixed daytime hours from Monday to Friday? Join the Packaging department at Rhenus and help ensure medical products are processed and prepared safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

- Load and unload incoming and outgoing deliveries
- Perform quality checks on products
- Pick, pack, and prepare orders
- Prepare shipments for safe and timely transport
- Assemble and disassemble wooden crates

Your work plays an important role in keeping daily operations running smoothly and ensuring medical supplies are delivered accurately, safely, and on time.

Who we’re looking for:

- You are able to communicate in Dutch and/or English
- You are reliable, motivated, and eager to learn
- You have some experience in logistics
- You are available full-time (40 hours per week)

jobs.occupation: Part-time order picker AS Watson in Heteren (113823003)
jobs.description:
As a part-time order picker at AS Watson, you play an important role in supplying well-known stores like Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL. You work at the distribution center in Heteren, where a headset tells you exactly which products to pick and where to place them. You handle both small and larger products, walk a lot, and keep your fitness up at the same time. You can choose your own shifts: morning (06:00–14:00), afternoon (14:00–22:00), or night (22:00–06:00, for 3-shift schedule). Prefer to work weekends only? That's possible too! Apply today and we'll discuss the options with you. 

- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available at least 16 hours per week
- Available at least one Saturday every 4 weeks. 
- You are fit enough to walk a lot
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren
- You want to work in shifts

Are you looking for a full-time job in logistics? Then you are at the right place at PostNL in Waalwijk. We offer you a long-term job with security! Guaranteed 4 days work! Also, you can earn up to € 29,42 per hour. Curious about what awaits you as a warehouse employee at PostNL in Waalwijk? Read on quickly!

What we offer
- Salary: € 14,99 per hour!
- On Sunday you earn € 29,98 per hour!
- Guaranteed 32 hours!
- Allowances of 20% and 30% after 10 pm
- Weekly payment!
- Travel allowance from 6 kilometers

Who you are
As a full-time warehouse employee at PostNL Waalwijk, you will be busy with packages all day. This means a lot of standing, walking, and lifting packages. Also:

- You have your own transport to come to PostNL in Waalwijk
- You speak the Dutch or English language
- You are able to remove all piercings, jewelry, and earrings for your workday.
- You are available for a minimum of three days
- You are available either the morning or evening shift
- You are in the possibility to lift parcels up to 20 kg, if needed.

What will you do
As a full-time warehouse employee at PostNL in Waalwijk, you will help support the sorting process. This ensures that every package goes out on time and can be delivered to the correct address. All packages are placed on the conveyor belt by another department. Then the sorting machine sorts the packages by region. After that, the packages fall into different chutes near you. Then comes the final sorting. This is done by postal code. You check the postal code and place the package in the correct roll container behind you.

- Working days: Monday to Sunday (weekends are on a rotational basis).
- Working hours: Day shifts from 09:00 AM - 18:30 PM and Evening shift from 17:30 PM - 02:30 AM

Where will you work
The large blue building of Bol.com is almost impossible to miss. You ensure that all packages are sorted here with many other colleagues. The warehouse is located at Pakketweg 2 in Waalwijk. It is close to the highway and e

Do you enjoy working with your hands and with different materials?

Composite material is made up of multiple materials bonded or laminated together. Think panels, interior parts, and structural aircraft components. As a Composite Shop Worker, you'll repair and maintain these parts. You're comfortable working with a range of materials: composite, plastic, metal, and interior materials. You carry out repairs according to fixed technical specifications and work instructions, working precisely with professional tools in a hangar or workshop environment. You'll also identify and resolve damage to interior and composite components, a role that combines the best of sheet metal work and interior work.

- You have experience working with different materials, or a relevant technical education (e.g. in sheet metal work, composites, or interior construction)
- You have a precise, careful way of working
- You're willing to (further) build your technical expertise
- You speak good English (technical drawings are all in English)
- You're comfortable working with computers; administration is also part of the job
- You're willing to occasionally work evenings and weekends (on average once every 4 weeks - after 8 months from starting)
- Experience in car body repair, automotive interiors, or manufacturing work involving composite/plastic materials is a plus

Are you looking for an active warehouse job that fits perfectly with your personal life? Then this is your chance! We are currently looking for motivated order pickers and packers who can start immediately and are available for both morning and afternoon shifts. Using modern tools such as hand scanners and voice picking, you will collect orders quickly and accurately. You make sure every order is complete and ready for shipment.

In this role, you will stay active throughout the day and play an important part in keeping the logistics process running smoothly.

Working hours (2 shift system):

- Morning: 07:00 – 16:00
- Afternoon: 16:00 – 00:00

- You speak English or Dutch
- You are available at least 2 days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2 shift system
- You are physically able to perform active work (standing, walking, lifting)
- No experience is required, motivation are most important
- Resident of the Netherlands
- Valid work permit for the Netherlands required
- No housing available

Are you looking for an active job in logistics?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can be delivered to customers on time.

Your responsibilities include placing packages on the sorting conveyor belt, processing sorted shipments, and supporting the daily logistics operation. You will work Monday to Friday and be available 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Start and end times may vary.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier or difficult to lift, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available for at least 3 to 4 days per week
- You are at least 18 years old
- You speak Dutch or English
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center

As a credit controller, you are responsible for the complete management of accounts receivable. In this position, you will work 40 hours per week in a dynamic and international team. You will find yourself in an environment where flexibility, proactivity, and eagerness to learn are key. There is plenty of room to develop further; the company offers multiple training opportunities and possibilities for advancement. This is a long-term position where you will work with modern systems and tools.

You start your working day by checking outstanding payments and monitoring payment deadlines. Next, you contact customers about overdue invoices, send reminders, and follow up by phone where necessary. You are proactive in identifying and resolving payment risk issues and work closely with other departments such as sales and customer service to improve processes. Throughout the day, you handle daily receivables processing, keep the administration up to date, and accurately document all customer communications.

Are you accurate, service-oriented, and strong in communication? Apply now for this challenging credit controller position. Take the next step in your career today and make a difference in an international organization.

- 

- Completed mbo or hbo degree, preferably in business administration

- At least 3 years of experience as a credit controller

- Excellent command of English, both spoken and written; knowledge of Dutch or other languages is a plus

- Strong skills in Microsoft Excel and financial systems

- Accurate, flexible, and proactive in a team environment

    - Unloading packages and shipments

For Arvato in Heijen, we are looking for warehouse employees! You make sure that orders are carefully collected, packed, and shipped. If you perform well, there is a chance of being taken over by the company. Read on quickly!

As a warehouse employee, you make sure that orders are processed neatly and on time. You work at the picking line and are responsible for collecting, scanning, checking, and preparing products for shipment.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary contract through Manpower with the possibility of a permanent contract if you perform well

Are you ready for a flying start with a spectacular salary? As a logistics employee at DPD in Berkel en Rodenrijs, you will earn a great base wage of € 14.99 per hour. But it gets even better! You will work only in the morning, so the rest of the day is free! On top of that, we can discuss your schedule that fits your life perfectly. Read on quickly and claim this top job today!

What we offer
- A top salary of € 14.99 gross per hour 💸
- A lot of free time!
- Weekly payouts right after the weekend
- Travel allowance 🚗
- A great chance to get a permanent contract
- A dynamic and international team

Who you are
Do you love precision and speed? As a logistics employee, you see it as a sport to guide every package smoothly through the warehouse. You are reliable and ready to make an impact. To keep the warehouse running smoothly, it is important that you meet the following criteria:

- You are 18 years or older to ensure workplace safety
- You speak English or Dutch
- You have your own transport to reach Berkel en Rodenrijs
- You are preferably available for 5 days a week
- You are physically able to lift packages up to 23 kg

What will you do
Working as a logistics employee at DPD means action, energy, and great rewards! You are the driving force behind the sorting process. Together with your team, you make sure that all packages end up in the correct containers at lightning speed. Because you work efficiently, the time flies by, and your bank account grows fast. It is an active job that keeps you fit while you earn cash easily!

Where will you work
You will work in the modern DPD warehouse at the Celsiusstraat in Berkel en Rodenrijs. The working atmosphere here is informal, warm, and full of fun. Hard work and laughing together go hand in hand! After your shift, you can relax in the cozy canteen with a fresh cup of coffee. DPD truly believes in your talent and offers opportunities to grow your career! #baanrader

Do you want to work as a Production Worker in the food production industry in Zoetermeer? In this role as Production Worker, you and your colleagues help produce and package meat products. You work in a modern production environment where hygiene and quality are important. As a Production Worker, your work is varied and the results of your work are visible right away.

What you get in this job

- Hands-on work in a production environment
- Working together with colleagues in a close team
- The chance to learn different production tasks
- Opportunities to grow into roles such as machine operator

Your shift starts early in the morning in the production area. You check in with your team and get ready for the day’s production. Together you make sure everything runs smoothly so the products are processed and packed on time. Because the company works with fresh products, flexibility during the workday is important.

As a Production Worker, your tasks include:

- Packing products so they are ready for transport
- Working in different departments such as production or seasoning
- Operating and maintaining production machines
- Keeping your workspace clean and safe
- Thinking along about improvements in the production process

You enjoy practical work and like working with colleagues to create products people enjoy.

Enjoying practical work and being part of a team is important for this role.

Requirements:

- Availability for at least 4 days per week
- Ability to communicate in Dutch and/or English
- Ability to work in a food production environment

Preferred:

- Previous experience in production work
- Interest in working with machines
- Accurate and hygienic way of working
